# Laboratory calculators in LabGuide — math appendix

<!-- GENERATED by video_studio/scripts/docs.mjs -->

**Illustrative inputs — not a patient.** Every result in the video is computed **by the app** on the filmed screens (`flutter_walk/calculators_walk_test.dart`). This appendix repeats the arithmetic only as a check. The hook shows the app's formula text with "= ?" and no result.

| Screen | Inputs | App on screen | JS (video lib) | Python (independent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| eGFR · CKD-EPI 2021 (`e_result`) | creatinine 88 µmol/L, age 45, male | 95 mL/min/1.73 m², KDIGO G1 | 95.10 (÷ 88.4) | 95.1059 (molar mass 113.12 g/mol), G1 |
| eGFR, age 12 (`e_child`) | same, age 12 | refused (under 18) | — | — |
| Dilution (`d_result`) | C₁ 10, C₂ 2, V₂ 100 mL | V₁ = 20 mL | 20 | 20 |
| Calculated osmolality (`o_unit`) | Na 140, glucose 90 "mmol/L", urea 5 | 375 mOsm/kg + unit check on glucose | 375 | 375 |

CKD-EPI 2021 (as in `lib/features/tools/calc_info.dart`): eGFR = 142 × min(Scr/κ, 1)^α × max(Scr/κ, 1)^−1.200 × 0.9938^age × 1.012 [if female]; female κ = 0.7, α = −0.241; male κ = 0.9, α = −0.302; Scr in mg/dL.

## What the numbers do NOT mean

- No patient, no interpretation of "G1", no reference interval. The glucose-90 example exists only to show the app's unit check.
